description:
👇 Get the complete Collapse-Proof Home Manual (250+ pages & 150+ field-tested methods across 13 survival systems) 


About Collapse Lab: here we teach calm, practical, sourced preparedness for regular families — the quiet self-reliance the comfortable, connected world taught us to outsource.

The Collapse-Proof Home Manual is general preparedness education — not professional, medical, legal, or financial advice, and not a prediction of any specific event. Cole Merritt is a composite educational character presented as a digital presence. Methods are drawn from public sources including FEMA Ready.gov, the American Red Cross, the CDC, and the USDA; always verify your local rules and follow all manufacturer and safety instructions before applying any method — especially anything involving fuel, fire, generators, carbon monoxide, water, or food.
